profile.name: Muhammad Shah Jalal
profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer & Technical Support Engineer
profile.summary: Software professional with 4+ years of experience across full-stack development, technical support, and quality assurance — one continuous track record of building products and keeping them running for the people who use them. Builds scalable web applications, custom e-commerce platforms, and REST APIs (documented with Swagger) with Laravel/PHP, WordPress/WooCommerce, and React, backed by MySQL/MariaDB (master–slave replication) and PostgreSQL. At Strontium Corp (Canada, remote), that same experience runs support for three AI SaaS products end to end — Help Scout ticket ownership, defect reproduction, testing failed jobs against internal ML backend APIs, and production QA — in a 15+ member global team providing 24/7 support in English. Adds hands-on infrastructure depth: VPS and Cloudflare DNS management, TCP/IP, routing, SSL/TLS and PKI, firewall rules, proxy and custom mail server configuration, and SSO/MFA (Authentik) — plus AI-assisted development and workflow automation with Codex, Claude, and local LLMs, including evaluating and benchmarking ML models for an ML team.
focusAreas: Technical support, QA and model evaluation

highlights.label: Technical Support
highlights.description: Own technical support for five AI SaaS products — Artistly, CloneVoice, TalkingPhotos, VideoExpress, and Videosly — across Help Scout, two Facebook product communities, and direct messages, in a 15+ member multi-region team providing 24/7 support in English; resolve tickets end to end, from first response and follow-up to a complete, tested answer, with Loom walkthroughs and Google Meet calls where needed. A sixth product, PodcastFlow (AI podcast creation, podcastflow.ai), is in beta testing and being added to my support scope.

highlights.label: Issue Resolution and Escalation
highlights.description: For failed generation jobs, take the user's job ID, extract the expected result, prepare prompts, and call internal ML backend APIs or the web apps to produce the correct result, return it to the user, and collect feedback. Triage community and ticket feedback into feature requests, critical issues, standard issues, and frustrated users; file Jira tasks tracked over Slack, escalate to developers and ML engineers, and follow up until the fix is verified and users are informed.

highlights.label: Quality Assurance
highlights.description: Production-team QA assignments: feature testing, API testing and comparison across multiple APIs (Postman, cURL), staging vs production API verification, and new-app and workflow testing, including browser automation via AI agents.

highlights.label: AI and ML Model Evaluation
highlights.description: Test local and newly hosted models for the ML team and send benchmark results with capability comparisons — including a four-model evaluation for agentic AI automation — documenting findings and recommending suitable models.

highlights.label: Feature Research That Shipped
highlights.description: Researched the CloneVoice pronunciation editor end to end and assisted the developer through to release; researched and submitted the Artistly Jigsaw puzzle feature; worked with an ML engineer on CloneVoice voice design using internal self-hosted TTS models.

highlights.label: AI Workflow Automation
highlights.description: Design and test AI-powered automation workflows for end users, including Nursery Rhyme Music Video and Vox-Style Documentary.

highlights.label: Identity and Access
highlights.description: Use Authentik single sign-on (SSO) and MFA daily across internal tools and support systems.

highlights.label: Mentorship and Reporting
highlights.description: Train and mentor junior support staff; keep a daily Jira task board and a Google Docs daily report with screenshot evidence for handled cases.
